evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/A/f implements Gson JsonSerializer<Color> and JsonDeserializer<Color>; it deserializes the integer field 'value' into java.awt.Color and serializes Color into an object containing 'value'=getRGB() and 'falpha'=0.0.
RuneLite HTTP API ColorTypeAdapter uses the same Color Gson adapter contract and its exact tests preserve the JSON shape containing 'value' and 'falpha'.
The class has no unrelated state or serialization target; its generic bridge methods resolve exclusively to java.awt.Color.

candidates.note: Historical RuneLite source identity plus exact-v308 Gson bytecode fixes ColorTypeAdapter.
